I’ve tried a lot of face cleansers, but the Origins GinZing takes the top spot. It’s gentle enough to use every day, yet powerful enough to scrub away oil, dirt, and city pollution without drying my skin. The fresh citrusy scent makes washing your face feel like a mini spa moment. A little really does go a long way—just a small amount lathers up nicely. My skin feels clean, smooth, and refreshed after every use. If you’re looking for a daily cleanser that actually delivers, this is the one.

I am a use of Origin products in this is by far one of my favorites from them. I have sensitive skin, so I look for things that don’t have a strong fragrance. This is perfect for just that. It has a light citrus smell that feels clean! Easy on the skin and does not irritate whatsoever. I use this for my face and body and notice a huge difference. I highly recommend this if you’re searching for an exfoliating cleanser that smells and feels clean!

avis.titre: Fantastic product: lasts, feels great, noticeable results, gentle, love the scentFantastic product: lasts, feels great,
avis.texte: A great exfoliator if you're looking for one; a superb addition to skincare regimes regardless of age (you can never start too early!* within reason) - I was looking for something to smooth out "patchy' looking/ feeling skin, and with this it feels and looks younger, smoother (I won't say it glows but it does feel that way!) This one by Origins is gentle on the skin - so it it suitable for sensitive and regular skin types alike - unlike many others which are harsh or grainy. I only use a small "blob" on one from a 2 pack of cheap, facial sponges I also found on amazon (pictured) and it works perfectly, leaving my skin feeling revitalised and looking brighter after only a few uses. Not much is needed per use, so for the cost of the bottle and how long it lasts it's a great investment in your face for a reliable brand. It lasts a long time so it's very good value for an excellent skincare brand - I've tried a few over the past 15+ years and always come back to this. Skin doesn't feel dry after use, it feels fresh and moisturised. I do follow up with Origins' Ginzing brightening moisturiser (aka the orange one - packaging has changed recently!) Usually I'd choose more "feminine" scents, like vanilla, shae, almond etc - but this just feels and radiates freshness. (There's also no clash at all with vanilla / honey & oat body oil; it's an effective product but a gentle one). Easily unisex. Look no further. Highly recommended.

Physical exfoliating products are usually quite harsh and stripping on the skin, this one however is surprisingly gentle. Leaves skin feeling smooth and replenished, highly reccommend to use 1-3 times a week depending on skin sensitivity. This claims to be suitable on all skin types, which is true. Although for inflamed skin, perhaps it's best to avoid exfoliating and focus instead on hydration and barrier repair.
